facts.fact: Ethiopia's Information Network Security Administration said it thwarted more than 50,000 cyberattacks in the first nine months of the 2025/26 fiscal year.
INSA reported more than 50,000 cyberattacks thwarted in the first nine months of 2025/26, against 13,494 in the previous year.

ETH.note: Critical-infrastructure law names 12 sectors but operators are designated later with reporting from July 2027, so no designation recorded.
Critical infrastructure cybersecurity law approved by Parliament in June and signed in July with incident reporting from July 2027; the document does not say it is in force, and no use is stated.

facts.fact: Addis Fortune says Ethiopia's Personal Data Protection Proclamation has been in force since July 2024.
The Proclamation names the Ethiopian Communications Authority as regulator of personal data, with a 72-hour breach notification duty to it; the article does not say the authority is constituted.
